name: t3-pilot-monorepo
description: Turn expiring AI quota into morning surprises — without touching 1% of your fresh cycle.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @t3-pilot/core && npm run build --workspace t3-pilot && npm run build --workspace @t3-pilot/cockpit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @t3-pilot/core && npm run typecheck --workspace t3-pilot && npm run typecheck --workspace @t3-pilot/cockpit
